other.最初から激戦でしたね……。\nこれが噂に名高い『人気闘兵』！\nどきどきしてしま: It's been a fierce battle from the start… This is the famed “Popular Battle”! My heart's racing!
other.最初に聞いたときは、\n何を血迷ったのかと思ったが、\nどうやら成功しているらし:
When I first heard about it, I thought they'd lost their mind,
but it seems they've actually succeeded.
other.最初のグループから、\nいっぱい票が入っていましたね……。: The first group got a ton of votes, didn't they…?

other.最初はほとんど巻き込まれたようなものでしたが、\nここまで来れば私も気合が入りま: At first it felt like I was just dragged in, but now I'm really fired up.

Those who were hesitant at first are now flocking to the combatant boxes,
so the voting's only going to get more heated from here.
other.最初は殺伐とした雰囲気に\nどうしたものかと思いましたが、\n最終的には全部まる: At first the atmosphere was so grim I wondered what to do, but in the end everything rounded out nicely.
other.最強ッ！ 王子ッ！ 決定戦ッ！！\nそう、本戦出場を決めた、\nあの英雄王を継ぐ:
The Strongest! Prince! Decisive Battle!!
Yes, a challenge has arrived for the one who will inherit that heroic king, now set for the main tournament!!
other.最後に、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Finally, note that defeating enemies yields no EXP, gold, or item drops.
other.最後の投票、めいっぱい暴れちゃうからね！: I'll go all out in the last vote!
other.最近じゃ、この近くの森にも魔獣がちらほら姿を\n見せるようになったし、もしかした: Lately, even the forest near here has been showing up with stray beasts, and maybe they're being controlled by the beasts themselves...
other.最近の人気闘兵はお祭りみたいになってますし、\n盛り上げるためには王子さまの力が: These popularity battles have turned into festivals lately, and maybe they need the Prince's power to really hype things up…?
other.最近は天界出身の子も王国に増えてきましたからね。\n故郷を盛り上げてあげたい王子: These days, more kids from the heavens are joining the kingdom. I get why the Prince wants to boost his hometown.
other.本体が起動しない問題は？: What's the issue with getting the main body online?
other.本当なら再会を喜びたいところですけど、\nそれは今回の事件が片付いてからになりそ:
I'd love to celebrate our reunion, but
that'll have to wait until this incident is resolved…
other.本当に、そのとおりだな。\n義理堅さは父君譲りということかもしれない。:
That's exactly right.

other.本当に、嵐のような事件でしたね……。: Edo Castle — It truly was a storm of an incident…
other.本当に皆さん頑張ってくれましたからね。\n並大抵の努力ではなかったでしょうに……: It's because everyone truly gave their all. It wasn't just ordinary effort…
other.本当に！\n誰に投票しようか私も迷ってしまいます……。:
Really!
I'm torn about who to vote for…
other.本来ならば、メイドである私には\n過分な評価といえますが……。: Normally, as a maid, such praise would be more than I deserve...

other.東の国のおさむらいさんたちが、\n大勢集まっちゃってますよ……？: Samurais from the Eastern lands have gathered in large numbers...?
other.楽器は王族のたしなみですから。\nとはいえ、東の国から寄贈された時には、\nあま:

its sheer size truly surprised me.
other.様々な種族や生い立ちを持つ者から、\n多種多様なスキルと武具を操る方々が仲間とな: People of various races and backgrounds, wielding a wide array of skills and weapons, have become our allies, and our forces have become stronger than we could have imagined not long ago.
other.模擬戦で気兼ねなく魔法をぶっ放せるよう、\n魔法都市関係者の総力を上げて、\n強: To let everyone unleash magic freely in the mock battle, the Magic City officials have pooled their resources and set up a strong barrier.
other.次なる時代に輝くスター！\nその決着をつける最後の戦いが、始まったーッ！！: A star shining into the next era! The final battle to settle it has begun!!

When the worlds intersect next time,
I hope we can have a calm, gentle conversation…

other.此なるはゴマ団子……。\n吾が作った……菓子じゃ。: These are sesame dumplings… a confection I made.
other.此の領域デあれば、\nその為の手駒を揃えることも容易イ――: In this domain, gathering the pieces I need would be easy—
other.此ノ身もまた、境界の軋みが生ジせしめタ泡沫。\n誰ゾの夢に立チ昇る、蜃気楼とイえ:
This body too is just a fleeting bubble born from the creaking of the boundary.
Even if it's a mirage that rises in someone's dream.
other.武人には教養があってこそ、ですからね。\nさすがはタカマガハラ指折りの武人。\n: A warrior must have culture, after all. That's why he's a top-notch samurai from Takamagahara, with the power to settle any disturbance.
other.死ぬ……これ以上は死ぬ……。: I'm dying… I can't go on any further…
other.死合いは好物ですが、\n今回の主役を差し置いて楽しむほど、\n私は節操なしではあ: I do enjoy a good deathmatch, but I'm not so reckless as to ignore the main event this time.
other.殿さん、王子さん、\n次に会えるのはいつになるのでしょう……。\nなんだか寂しい: My lord, Prince… When will we meet again? I feel… lonely.
other.民が安心して暮らし、\n研究を続けていける環境を整えることで、\n平和な未来への: By creating an environment where the people can live safely and research can continue, we can lay the foundation for a peaceful future.
other.気合十分、大変よろしい！\nばりばり集計しちゃいましょう！: Full of spirit, splendid! Let's tally them up vigorously!
other.気軽に会いに行けない距離だからこそ、\n一つの繋がりを大事にしていきたいものです:
Because we can't just pop over casually, we should cherish the connections we do have.

other.汚名返上の舞台としてはうってつけというわけさ。: It's the perfect stage to clear our tarnished reputations.
other.汝がこうして……花束を抱え、\n吾を言祝ぎにきてくれたのじゃ。: You, holding a bouquet, have come to celebrate me.

other.決戦の場に来られなかった子たちも、\n投じられた票には、たしかに意味があるのよ。: Even the kids who couldn't make it to the battlefield, their votes still matter.
other.決戦闘兵の場に立つ者は、\n各グループの意志を継いだ勇者でもあるからね。\n破れ: Those who stand on the final battlefield are also the heroes who inherit each group's will. I hope they give their all—for those who fell.
other.泣いても笑ってもこれで決着！\nそれじゃあサオシュちゃん、\n決戦闘兵開始の宣言: Whether we cry or laugh, this settles it! Now then, Saoshu-chan, go ahead and announce the start of the decisive battle!
other.深海でも呼吸ができる……。\nこれが海巫女の扱う秘術なのですね。: I can even breathe underwater… This must be the secret art wielded by the Sea Priestess.
other.深海にも地上にも、\n大勢の強者がいますからね。: There are plenty of strong ones both in the deep sea and on the surface.

other.深海も地上も、まだまだ平和な世にはほど遠いからなぁ。\nそれでも、せっかくのお祭: Both the deep sea and the surface are far from peaceful… Still, since it's a festival, I hope you all enjoy it to the fullest.
other.準備はいいか？ いいよな？\nよーし、それじゃあ\n『大討伐ミッション』の始まり: Are you ready? You are, right? Alright, then—let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
other.激しい戦いでしたが、\nどうにかコピーの撃退に成功しましたね……。: Anna — It was a fierce battle, but we managed to repel the copy… after all.
other.炎に包まれた鳥の頭を持つ魔物……。: A monster with a bird's head wreathed in fire…
other.無事にお説教を切り抜けられたら、ですかねー。: Grimm — If we can get through the sermon unscathed, that is.

other.無回答──緊急時行動規定を採用、行動を開始。: No response—emergency action protocol engaged, commencing operations.
other.無法者達への正規訓練の実施や、風紀の維持ならびに\n強化を意図した講習などは常日: We regularly conduct formal training for outlaws, maintain discipline, and hold enhancement lectures, but even that isn't enough to handle the challenges looming before us.
other.無礼講だ、顔面を殴られようが文句は言わぬぞ？: No holds barred—won't complain even if you punch me in the face.

other.無論、最初からだ。\nそれよりもムルーアよ、次のグループの\n投票が始まるのでは: Of course, I've been here from the start. More importantly, Murua, isn't the next group's voting about to begin?
other.無論、未知なる強者の発掘だ。\n王子の活躍で戦神コロッセウムは大盛況だが、\n俺: Of course, to discover unknown champions. The Prince's feats have made the War God Colosseum a huge hit, but I, as the organizer, must plan the next one.
other.無限書庫の深奥は、\n歴代の里長が徹底して封印し続けてきた禁断の知識の宝庫だ。\:
The depths of the Infinite Library are a vault of forbidden knowledge that every village head has painstakingly sealed away.
We should prepare for anything before we head in.
other.焦って損しただに。\nところで、強力な妖力って何のことだに？:
You rushed and got yourself into trouble.

Indeed. Yet, what matters in the end is one's daily training.

other.然リ……業腹ナレドモ、異論ナシ。: Indeed… though it's a karmic burden, I have no objection.
other.特に深海の民にとっては、\n自分たちの街で開いた初めての人気闘兵、\nその覇者と: Especially for the deep-sea folk, it's the first popular battle held in their own city, and becoming its champion means everything.
other.狭間に満チたる夢より出づる、我が同胞ヨ……！: From the dreams that fill the void, my comrades arise…!

other.王国の皆さんの熱気にあてられて、\n私も耳がぴこぴこしちゃいます……！: The excitement of everyone in the kingdom is making my ears tingle!
other.王国軍なら、きっとみんなのハートを熱くできるさ。\nそれじゃあ第八回人気闘兵――: With the Kingdom army, we'll definitely fire up everyone's hearts. So, let's kick off the 8th Popular Battle!
other.王国軍の船乗りは全員、誰に似たのか人が好すぎだ。\nおれがこいつを、正しく『海賊: All the kingdom's sailors are way too popular, looking just like someone people adore. I'll raise this one into a proper pirate.
other.王国軍諸兄姉よ、準備の方は大丈夫かい？\n魔法の闘兵箱の設置はもう済んでいるんだ: Brothers and sisters of the Kingdom forces, are you all set? The magical battle-box should be installed by now, right? Got your battle tickets? Have you picked your desired opponent?
other.王城さんは王城なのに初めてなんですか？: Is this your first time at the Royal Castle, even though you're the Royal Castle?
other.王子……。\n何度も戦っている相手ではありますが、\nくれぐれも油断はしないでく: Prince… Though we've faced each other many times, don't let your guard down.
other.王子……この度は、\n私からの急な申し出に賛同して頂き、\n本当にありがとうござ: Prince… Thank you for agreeing to my sudden proposal. I truly appreciate it.
other.王子……！\n敵は普段の小規模な軍勢とは異なります。\n軍を相手取るとなれば相応:
Prince…!
The enemy isn't like the usual small skirmishes.
If we're to face an army, we'll need proper groundwork…
other.王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
other.王子、あなたの誓いは私が守ってみせる！: Prince, I'll keep the oath you made!
other.王子、これからもよろしくお願いしますね。: Prince, I look forward to continuing to work together.
other.王子、これまでの悪霊の迷宮攻略、\nそして最後の部屋の攻略、お疲れさまでした！: Prince, thank you for clearing the Evil Spirit Labyrinth and conquering the final chamber!
other.王子、ご挨拶が遅れましたこと\n誠に申し訳ありません。: Prince, I sincerely apologize for my delayed greeting.
other.王子、ただいまグループＢの投票が、\n開催中とのことです。: Prince, Group B's voting is currently underway.

Prince, let's first meet up with the castle maidens,
and then… Your Highness?—let's join them!
other.王子、グループＣの投票が始まりました。: Prince, the voting for Group C has begun.
other.王子、勝鬨を上げるわよ。兵士たちが待ってるわ。: Prince, raise the war cry. The soldiers are waiting.

other.王子、強大な戦闘能力をもった魔物の出現が\n報告されました。: Prince, reports have come in of a monster with overwhelming combat power appearing.
other.王子、歩みを止めぬ、\nこの世界の希望の灯火たる者よ。: Prince, the unceasing stride, the beacon of hope for this world.
other.王子、特別賞については後ほど『お知らせ』を\nしますので、見逃さないでくださいね: Prince, we'll announce the special prize later, so don't miss it, okay?
other.王子、田園を守るため『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission to protect the fields!
other.王子、研究予算くれますかー？: Prince, could you spare some research funds?
other.王子、迎撃に向かわれるのであれば\nこれまでとは比べ物にならない壮絶な\n戦いが: Prince, if you head to intercept it, you should expect a battle far more brutal than anything we've faced before.
other.王子。百鬼夜行という言葉をご存知ですか……？\n集団でさまよう妖怪たちのことを指: Prince, are you familiar with the term “Hyakki Yagyō”?… It refers to a horde of wandering yokai.
other.王子がどなたに投票しているのかも気になりますが、\nここで聞いてはフェアではあり: I'm curious who you, Prince, are voting for, but it wouldn't be fair to ask now. I'll look forward to the results when they're announced.
other.王子さま、\nいったいどこへ行っちゃったんでしょうねー……。: Prince, where on earth could he have gone…?
other.王子さまが助けてくれたので、\nハプニングで済みましたけどね。危ないところでした:
Thanks to you rescuing me, Prince,
it was just a hiccup. That was a close call.
other.王子さまと白の皇帝の絡み！\nまさかこの目で見られるなんて！\n筆が！ 捗って！:
The Prince and the White Emperor interacting!
I never thought I'd see it with my own eyes!
My pen! It's flowing! I can't stop!
other.王子さん、あなたの力を見せてください。\nあなたの、本当の、最大の力を。:
Prince, show me your power.
Your true, ultimate power.
other.王子とどうしても戦ってみたかった、\nなんて言っている魚人もいたわ。\nどこへ行: There were even mermen who said they just had to fight the Prince. No matter where you go, the Prince is a hit.
other.王子の前にいるときのアリシア、\nほんとに全部顔に出てるよ？: When you're in front of the Prince, Alicia, everything really shows on your face.
other.王子の好きなものも、たくさんいれてみた。: I also tossed in plenty of things you like.
other.王子の強さは私たちドワーフの里にまで\n知れ渡ってるくらいだし、一緒に闘ってくれ: The Prince's strength is known all the way to our dwarf village—if you'll fight alongside us, there's no more reassuring ally than you.
other.王子の旦那が乗り気ってことなら、\nこのまま人気闘兵を\n開催しちゃっても平気そ: If the Prince's “husband” is enthusiastic, does that mean we can just go ahead and hold the popularity tournament as is?
other.王子は『お知らせ』から既にご存知かもしれませんが、\n男性の方など、各部門で賞を: Prince, you may have already seen the announcement, but we've prepared prizes for men and each category! If you have someone you're rooting for, be sure to cast your vote!!
other.王子はどなたに投票するか、\nもうお決まりですか？: Prince, have you decided who you'll vote for yet?
other.王子も有名になると、オークさんが魔界から\n戦いに挑んで来たりするのですね……。: Once the Prince becomes famous, even the Orcs from the demon realm will come to challenge us... Thankfully, they're polite Orcs, so that helped.
other.王子殿、で良かったか……？\nやはり、私の知り合いがあちらにいるようだ。\nどう: Is it okay to call you Prince? It seems someone I know is over there. Please let me lend a hand in this fight.
other.王子殿下、冗談みたいな姿ですが、\nあの第六天黒竜魔王娘マウロ、\n放置すれば他: Prince, it may look like a joke, but that Sixth-Heaven Black Dragon Demon-King Daughter, Mauro, will affect the other three worlds if we leave her unchecked.
other.王子殿下、王国の皆さんのおかげで、\n翠花の都の復興も大きく進み、\nお祭りも大: Your Highness, thanks to you and everyone in the kingdom, the reconstruction of the Emerald City has progressed greatly, and the festival has been a roaring success.
other.王子殿下とクラールフ様が同盟関係になったからこそ、\nこうしてあたしたちは交流で: It's because Prince and Klaarf have formed an alliance that we can interact like this, right?
other.王子殿下らしいというか、なんというか……。\nともあれ、私たちの街も準備万端です: That's so… princely of you. Anyway, our city is all set. We can start the “Popular Battle” whenever you're ready.
other.王子直々の頼みだったしねー。\n決戦闘兵前に、ようやくちょっと一休みって感じ。: It was a direct request from the Prince, after all. Finally getting a little break before the decisive troops.
other.王子！ 『千鬼夜行』という言葉を知っていますか？: Prince! Have you heard of the term “Senki Yako”?
other.王子！ 一緒に森にきてくれよ！\nアタシ聞いたんだぞ！？\n王子はスゴく強くて、: Prince! Come with me to the forest! I heard it yourself—you're incredibly strong and kind to beast-folk!
other.現在、帝国東部の港町が、\nダークエルフによる襲撃を受けている。: Currently, a port town in the empire's east is under attack by dark elves.
other.現在、皆さまの世界に、\n超次元生命体ホロウクルスが接近しています。: Currently, the hyperdimensional lifeform Hollowkruls is approaching your world.
other.現在は、過去と未来の因果が確定していないという、\n極めて例外的な状況です。\n: Right now we're in an extremely exceptional situation where the causality of past and future hasn't been fixed yet. In that case, rather than contacting our past selves—
other.生まれてくる時代が少しだけ悪かったね。\n平和な世の中なら稀代の名君だったのにさ: You were just born in a slightly off era. In a peaceful world, you'd have been a legendary ruler.
other.申し訳ありませんが、そういうわけにもいかないのです。\nこれがわたくしの使命であ: I'm sorry, but that just isn't an option. This is my mission, my very reason for existing.
other.異世界への侵略──すなわち広義の破廉恥！: Invasion of another world—essentially, a grand act of indecency!
other.異次元に……？ 一体どういうことだ。: Another dimension…? What on earth does that mean?
other.疲れて油断したところを喰い殺されるのがオチだ。\n返り討ちに遭いたくないのなら、: She'll eat you up when you're tired and let your guard down. If you don't want a counter-attack, stop the pursuit.
other.発音が難しいと思いますので、\nたわーとお呼びください。: The name's a mouthful, so just call me “Tawā.”
other.皆さまの世界の命運は、\nこの戦いに懸かっていると言えるでしょう。: The fate of your world hangs on this battle.
other.皆さんとっても強くて素敵でかっこよくて、\nキュンキュンでぴょんぴょんでした！: Everyone was so strong, wonderful, and cool—it made my heart flutter and my feet bounce!
other.皆さんのおかげで、\n都市にも観客にも被害はゼロです！\n大変お世話になりますぅ: Thanks to everyone, there's been zero damage to the city or the spectators! We really appreciate it.
other.皆さんのご厚意に甘えて、\nぜひ人気闘兵会場にてお披露目会をさせていただきます。: We'll gladly accept everyone's kindness and showcase it at the Popular Battle arena.
other.皆さんの人気を集めているのは誰なのでしょう？\n票数の確認は箱に選ばれし者たる私: I wonder who's gathering all the popularity… Checking the votes is my privileged duty as the chosen one! I'll tally them perfectly!
other.皆の「憧憬」と「興奮」が溢れている……。\nこれは妖怪たちにも、\n良い食事をさ:
Everyone's longing and excitement are overflowing…
Looks like we can even treat the youkai to a good meal.
other.目の前で神話のような光景──いえ、\n神話そのものを目撃してしまったのだもの。\: Right before our eyes, a scene straight out of myth—no, we actually witnessed a myth itself. No wonder we're all heated up.
other.目標はホロウパンプキンデウス、ね？: The target's the Hollow Pumpkin Deus, right?
other.相手のことを理解したい、\n困っていたら助けたい、肩を並べて戦いたい。: I want to understand the opponent, help them if they're in trouble, fight side by side.
other.知っていても、あんな勢いで突撃されたら誰だって驚く。\n――おっと、それより王子:
Even if she knows, anyone would be surprised by that sudden charge.
—Oops, more importantly Prince, we have a report.
other.知ってるか？\n魔獣っていうのは、そもそも、とっても凶暴な獣たちなんだ。: Did you know? Beast beasts are inherently ferocious creatures.
other.短い平穏であったな。\nしかし、こちらの準備は万端であるぞ？\nなぁレーヴよ。: That brief peace was nice. But we're fully prepared, right? Hey, Reve.
other.研究を続けていける、というのが入るあたりが、\nエステル様だという感じがしますね: Saying “continue research” really sounds like something Estelle would say.
other.研究者たちからすれば、\nディアスの要塞宮殿についての王子の所感を\n聞きたかっ: The researchers probably want to hear his thoughts on the Fortress Palace of Dias.
other.破廉恥許すまじ、と。: We must not allow such shamelessness.
other.確か、ご主人さまの脱ぎたて衣装が\n盗まれたとかなんとか……？: If I recall, the master's freshly-worn costume was stolen or something…?
other.確かに……よく見ると、いえ、よく見なくても、\n頭がカボチャになってるの……。: Indeed… if you look closely—no, even without looking closely—its head is a pumpkin…
other.確かに、そう考えると熱も入りますね。\n熱心に訓練に励む新兵に\n入れようかとも: When you put it that way, it does get exciting. I was even thinking of giving it to a rookie who's training hard…
other.確かに、侵攻だけを考えていたなら、\n地上の民の呼吸のことまで考える必要はないで: Indeed, if they only thought about invasion, they wouldn't bother about the surface dwellers' breathing.
other.確かに観客は大歓声でしたねー。\nジンレイさんの戦い方は映えますから、\n見てる: The audience was definitely cheering loudly. Your fighting style, Jinrei-san, really shines, making it a blast for us spectators.
other.確か前回とは違う部門や、\n特別賞も用意されているんですよね。\nちょっとどきど: I recall there are new categories and even a special prize this time. I'm getting a bit excited…!
other.確実な証拠までは掴めていなかったんだ。\nそれと、こういう言い方はアレなんだが…: We hadn't secured solid evidence yet. Also, it's a bit awkward to put it that way, but…
other.確証はありませんし、\n本人に聞いても素直に答えてくれそうにはないので、\nあく: There's no proof, and she probably wouldn't answer honestly even if we asked, so this is just my guess…
other.祓剣主神さま、もしかして、\n分かってて武士の皆さんを焚き付けたんですかー！？: Futsunushi, did you deliberately stir up the samurai on purpose?!
other.祓剣主神さまが、\nあれこれと暗躍してたみたいですよー？: It seems Futsunushi has been pulling strings behind the scenes, huh?
other.祓剣主神様！\nいったいどこにいたんですかー！: Futsunushi! Where on earth have you been?!
other.祝祭は、息抜きであると同時に、戒めとなるべき行事でもある。\n羽目を外すのは祭り: Festivals are both a respite and a lesson. By allowing revelry only on festival days, we can keep everyday life peaceful and diligent.
other.神獣ユニコーンだよ。\n戦ったこと、あるでしょ？: A divine-beast unicorn. You've fought before, right?
other.祭りに乗じて兵を差し向けるような、\n無粋な手出しをしてくることはあるまい。: I won't stoop to the uncouth trick of sending troops under the guise of a festival.
other.禍々しさもまた、敵を威嚇するには重要ですよね。: A touch of menace can be useful for intimidating foes, after all.
other.私があなたをその島へ案内するから、\n兵を率いて退治して来てくれない？: I'll guide you to the island—will you lead a squad and take them out?
other.私がばら撒いたのではなく、\n皆が闘兵券を勝ち取っていったのですよ。: I didn't hand them out—everyone earned their battle tickets.
other.私が扱うのは時の魔法ですから、\n万が一にも周囲に影響を与えないよう、\nなにも: Since I'm dealing with time magic, I think we should conduct it in a place with nothing around so it won't affect anything, just in case.
other.私が王国に着任したばかりの時ですが、先の王から\n王国に伝わる文献を見せていただ: When I first joined the kingdom, the previous king showed me some ancient texts from our archives. They mentioned a demon god named Amon.
other.私たちと意思疎通がしやすいように、\n自動人形の身体を持ってもらったんです。: We gave her an automaton body so we could communicate more easily.
other.私ね。財宝をいーっぱい集めて名を上げて、\n海賊のみんなに一人前になったねって\: I want to gather a ton of treasure, make a name for myself, and have the other pirates recognize me as a true cut-throat.
other.私のこの銃の腕があれば、離れた敵だろうが\n確実に仕留めて見せるわ。: With my gun skills, I can take down any enemy, no matter how far away.
other.私のところの上司はこう言っていますが……。\n元魔王軍の私が、\n王国に滞在して: My superior says this… As a former Dark Lord army member, am I allowed to stay in the kingdom…?
other.私の名はミネルバ。\n巷じゃ『伝説の海賊』なんて言われてる\n名の知れた海賊よ。: My name's Minerva. Around these parts, they call me the “Legendary Pirate”—a pirate of some renown.
other.私の故郷のドワーフ族は、とっても昔から\nゴブリンたちと戦ってきたんだけど……。: My dwarf clan has been battling goblins for ages, but I've never seen them this... unstoppable.
other.私の誕生日は１２月２８日なので……そうですね、\n『１２位』と『２８位』の方に、: My birthday is December 28th, so… let's award the Civil Officer Prize to the contestants in 12th and 28th place.
other.私の領地が爆発で消し飛びかけたり、\n私の領地が水没しかけたりですね……。: My domain was nearly blown away by an explosion, and then it almost flooded….
other.私はまた会える気がするなー。\n予言ってほどじゃないんだけど。: I have a feeling we'll meet again. It's not exactly a prophecy, but…
other.私はまだ反対だけどね。\nこのタイミングで天界でだなんて、\n攻めてくださいと言: I'm still opposed, though. Inviting them to the heavens at this timing is like asking them to attack.
other.私はアリア、今回の『竜人の侵攻』の\n防衛戦の補佐をアンナ様より命じられました。: I am Aria. I was ordered by Anna to assist in the defense against the “Dragonfolk Invasion.” First, let me explain the dragonfolk.
other.私はドロシー。\n背は小っちゃいけど、これでもドワーフ族の戦士なんだよ。\n大地: I'm Dorothy. I may be short, but I'm still a dwarf warrior. Some even call me a earth fairy!
other.私は冥界の亜神、死せる者たちの\n魂を管理する者、亜神ヘカティエよ。\n覚えてお:
I am Hecatie, demi-god of the Underworld, keeper of the souls of the dead.
Remember that, humans.
other.私は完璧な塔だから。\n英傑の塔にも、悪霊の塔にも負けないし？:
I'm a perfect tower.
I won't lose to either the Tower of Heroes or the Tower of Evil Spirits, got it?
other.私は戦うことがなにより好きなわけではありませんよ。: I don't particularly love fighting above all else.
other.私は政務官ですからと、お断りしたのですが、\nシュシュさんがどうしても、と推すも: I tried to decline because I'm a civil officer, but Shushu-san kept insisting I join…
other.私は私を呼ぶ声を聞いた。\nならばそれに応えるのみよ。: I heard the call that summons me. Then I'll answer it, no other choice.
other.私は誅子様のこと好きだよ？\n強いし、優しいし、頭も良いし。: I really like you, Zhuzi—strong, kind, and smart.
other.私もそんな猛者の筋肉を間近で眺めた――\nこほんっ、そんな猛者の皆さんを応援した: I also got to see those mighty muscles up close— ahem, I want to cheer on all those strong folks!
other.私も投票しに行きたいのですが……うぅぅ～。\n皆さん素敵すぎて迷っちゃいます……: I want to go vote too, but… ugh. They're all so wonderful I can't decide!
other.突然ですが王子、\n我が軍を総動員しての大演習の開催を進言します！: Prince, may I propose launching a massive joint exercise, mobilizing all our forces at once!
other.突貫作業で三世界間の調整をするのは骨が折れたねー。: Pulling off the three-world coordination on the fly really took a toll.
other.立役者が先に帰るのは許されないみたいね。: Looks like the star can't leave before everyone else.
other.竜人……いや、この少年の知り合いということは、\nモンスター娘殿……なのか……？: A drake… no, you must be acquainted with that boy, so you're the monster maid…?
other.竜人は、ああ見えて聡明な種族だから。\n誇りと名誉、そして強さを大切にするけれど: The draconians may look that way, but they're actually an intelligent race. They value pride, honor, and strength, and they cherish the children of the future just as much.
other.竜人は長寿ですが繁殖能力が低く\n個体数は多くありません。\n人数でいえば我々が: Dragonfolk live long lives but have low reproductive rates, so their numbers aren't high. In terms of sheer numbers, we have the advantage.
other.端的に言えば傍若無人で自分勝手。\n亜神ディアスの力を継いでいながら、\n縛られ:
In short, he's reckless, selfish, and a total troublemaker—
he inherited the power of the demi-god Dias, hates being bound, even tossed his own name away.
other.端的に言おう。\nーー王国軍の助力を頼みたい。:
I'll be blunt.
—We want the kingdom's assistance.
other.第六天黒竜魔王娘マウロ、だと！？: The Sixth-Heaven Black Dragon Demon-King Daughter, Mauro…?
other.第十二回人気闘兵、始まりまーす！: The twelfth Popular Battle is about to start!
other.第十二回人気闘兵はこれにて終了です。: The twelfth Popular Battle concludes here.
other.第十二回人気闘兵もいよいよ佳境に入り、\n間もなく新たなチャンピオンが決まります: The twelfth Popular Battle is reaching its climax, and a new champion will be decided soon.
other.第十六回人気闘兵、\n結果発表をお楽しみに♪: Stay tuned for the results of the 16th Popularity Battle♪
other.第十四回人気闘兵、\n結果発表をお楽しみに♪: Stay tuned for the results of the 14th Popular Battle!
other.箱の中がスゴイことになってますよぉ……。\n今回もとんでもない数の票が集まりまし: The box is blowing up in there…! We've collected an insane number of votes again!
other.箱を持ち込んだソニアが箱に選ばれし者とは。\nこれは、箱が運んできた巡り合わせと: Sonia, who brought the box, being the one the box selected… It must be fate's doing. But why do you know about this box?
other.結局あなたたちが犯人なんじゃないですかー！！: In the end, you're the ones responsible, aren't you—!!
other.結果として何が起きようと、\n世界が滅ぶよりはマシだろう？: No matter what happens, it's better than watching the world end, right?
other.統帥の塔です。\nとーすい様って呼んでもいいよ？:
I am the Tower of the Commander.
You can call me… Tōsui.
other.織田信長……か、コピーとはいえ、\n実に見事な戦いであった。\nしかし、妾たちの: Soleia — Oda Nobunaga… even as a copy, that was truly a magnificent fight. But he's not our enemy!
other.羽、というかヒレでしょうか……？\n生死をかけたものではない、\n交流のための模: Wings, or rather fins...? It's not a matter of life or death; it seems they're just enjoying a mock battle for camaraderie.
other.翠花の都の皆さんも楽しんでいるようで、\nやはり合同開催にして大正解でしたね。: Everyone in Suika seems to be having a great time—co-hosting was definitely the right call.
other.聞いたよ、華の国でお祭りを開くんだって？: I heard you're holding a festival in the Land of Flowers?
other.聞け、戦いを愛する全ての者よ！\n此度の試合、その名は――: Listen, all who love battle! This match, its name is—
other.職人が魔力を込めた逸品だから、\nその音色は味方を鼓舞し、\n敵を怯えさせる力を:
It's a masterpiece infused with magical energy,
its tone can inspire allies
and frighten foes.
other.肯定。アージェもマスターに、\nアージェの活躍を観測してほしいと考えています。: Absolutely. I also want the Master to watch Arge's exploits.
other.自分が応援している人に、\n応援してるよと伝えられる機会ですからね。\n皆張り切:
It's a chance to tell the ones we support that we're cheering for them.
I think everyone's really fired up.
other.自分の目で遺跡を見る経験は、\n短い人生、そう何度もあるものではないぞ。:
Seeing the ruins with your own eyes is a once-in-a-lifetime experience—
you won't get many chances in this short life.
other.自軍の被害を抑えるより、\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかっていうのが\n重要になってく: Rather than minimizing your own casualties, the focus is on how many foes you can slay.
other.自軍の被害を抑えるより、\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかっていうのが\n重要ね。: It's not about minimizing your own losses; it's all about how many foes you can bring down.
other.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: It's more important to kill as many foes as possible than to keep our own losses low.
other.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要！: It's more important to rack up kills than to minimize our own casualties!
other.興味は尽きないが、今は一つだけ訊ねよう。: I'm still fascinated, but there's one thing I need to ask right now.
other.良いんですっ！\n今回の人気闘兵を通じて、人間界にも\n素晴らしい猛者が集ってい:
That's fine!
Through this popular battle, we've learned that the human world also gathers wonderful warriors!
other.良いアイデアだからこそ、ですよ。\n企画書の提出は早めにお願いします。:
Because it's a good idea, after all.
Please submit the proposal early.
other.良かった！\nなにぶん古いシステムなので、\nちゃんと機能するか心配だったのです: Good! Because it's an old system, I was worried whether it would work properly.
other.英傑の塔さん！\nいい機会、というと？:
Tower of Heroes!
What do you mean by "good opportunity"?
other.英雄王がそうだったのでしょう？\n代わりに王子が来てくれたとはいえ、\nまさかも: That was the case with the Hero King, right? Even though the Prince took his place, have you truly forgotten that now?
other.草葉に置ク白露……水に宿ル月ヨリ、猶あやし。: White dew left on the grass… more mysterious than the moon that dwells in water.
other.華の国の武人たちにとっては合法的に、\n憎き余を殴り飛ばせる機会だろうからな。: For the warriors of the Flower Nation, it's a legitimate chance to knock the hated me out of the ring.
other.血沸き肉躍る闘兵の連続でしたから、\n私もつい手に汗を握ってしまいました。: The battles were blood-pumping, meat-dancing—so I couldn't help but get sweaty palms.
other.血湧き肉躍り、戦士の肉体がぶつかり合う、\n「戦神コロッセウム」を待ちきれぬ猛者:
Blood boiling, flesh dancing, warriors' bodies colliding—
those eager for the “War God Colosseum”! Yes, now! The time has come!!
other.血湧き肉躍る投票バトルロイヤル！\n一度戦場に足を踏み入れれば、\nそこから出ら: A blood-pumping, vote-battle royale! Once you step onto the battlefield, only the victor—or the dead—can leave!
other.行き先を選んでいる暇はない。\n確か、近しい世界が宇宙の外にいくつかあったな……:
We don't have time to pick a destination.
If I recall correctly, there are a few nearby worlds beyond the cosmos…?
other.行くぞ王子！\n世界の危機など、何度でも救えばいい！:
Let's go, Prince!
No matter how many times the world is in danger, we'll save it!
other.被害を最小限にするため、すでに放棄された居住区に\nわが軍の陣地を用意しました。: To minimize casualties, we've prepared our own positions in an abandoned residential area.
other.褒め褒めですよ。\nあー、すごい褒めてるなー。褒めてまーす。: It's high praise. Ah, I'm really praising you—praise, praise.
other.要するに首狩り戦術だ。\n王城の参戦で拠点の防衛に目途が立った、\nアイレンを筆: In short, it's a decapitation tactic. With the Royal Castle joining, we've got a foothold for defense, and led by Airen we'll force our way through the enemy waves.
other.見ていて楽しくはあるけどね。: It's entertaining to watch, I'll give you that.
other.見事な戦いぶりであった。\n……我が城主――いや、魔王ガリウスのコピーも、\n久: Maōjō? — What a splendid battle. Even the copy of Demon King Garius—my lord of the castle—seemed to have his heart racing after such a long fight.
other.親密になるという意味なら、\n今の最適な距離感でいることが一番だと思うわよ。: If by “tight” you mean close, I think keeping the perfect distance we have now is best.
other.観戦の前に、司会進行を忘れずにですよ？\nそれではジゼルさん、号令をお願いします: Before we watch, don't forget to handle the hosting duties. Giselle, please give the command.
other.言わないでくれよ、僕だって気にしている。\nいつだって敗戦処理は僕の役目だし、\:
Don't say that. I'm worried about it too.
Handling defeat is always my job, and the comrades who gather keep dying one after another.
other.討ち取ればホロウクルスの侵攻を、\nかなり遅らせることができるはずだ。: If we take him down, we should be able to delay the Hollow Crusade's invasion quite a bit.
other.討伐に向かう……ですか。分かりました！\nでは、これからの戦いについて説明を致し:
"You want to go on a extermination mission... Got it!
Then I'll explain the upcoming battle."
other.話はまとまったみたいね。: Looks like everything's fallen into place.
other.話は決まったようね！ 大丈夫、みんなは私が守るわ！: Looks like the plan's set! Don't worry, I'll protect everyone!
other.誰かを好きになる、誰かに憧れる……。\nそんな想いが、票にはこもっているのだもの: Falling in love, looking up to someone… those feelings are what fill the votes.
other.誰が楽しいだってー！？\nこっちはもう滅茶苦茶だよー！！: Who's having fun—?! This is a total mess!!
other.誰が遠足だって？: Who's calling this a field trip?
other.誰にだって、応援したい人や、\n活躍を見ていてほしい人はいるものだ。\n私だって:
Everyone has someone they want to support, someone they wish to see shine.
Even I… yeah…
other.誰に投票するべきか論争が再燃して、\n決戦闘兵もこの上なく盛り上がったぞ。: The debate over who to vote for reignited, and the final battle troops got more hype than ever.
other.誰のことかなー。まぁ、そういうわけでね、\n亜神ディアスが悪どいことし始めたって: Who's that, I wonder? Anyway, I heard the demi-god Dias has started causing trouble, so it's about time we wake him up.
other.誰もが強くあり続けることは、できない。\nそれくらいのこと――君も分かっているだ: No one can stay strong forever. You understand that, Prince?
other.誰も彼も他人のそれはよく気が付くが、\n我がことになると途端に鈍くなるものだ。: Everyone notices others' faults, but when it comes to themselves they become oblivious.
other.警備兵さんたちがあっちこっち走り回って、\nすっごい大忙しに見えますよー！？: The guards are running all over the place—it looks like total chaos!?
other.警備活動だけじゃなくて、\nそろそろ本格的に\n復興に取り掛からないとって思って: It's not just security—we've been meaning to start serious reconstruction soon, actually.
other.貴様のようなタイプの為政者は忘れがちだが、\n誰であれ『好きな相手の役に立ちたい: Rulers like you tend to forget, but anyone wants to help those they like.
other.貴様も、現在進行形で身に覚えがあるであろう？: You must be feeling that even now, aren't you?
other.貴様も魔界の上に立つ者であるならば、\n臣下にあまり我慢させるものではないぞ。: If you stand above the Demon Realm, you shouldn't make your subjects endure so much.
other.起動が遅れたのが痛手だったな。\n完成後、より警備の厳重な王城の真横に、\n飛空: The delayed activation was a real setback. After completion we planned to bring the airship right next to the heavily guarded royal castle.
other.超古代文明の船、その修理が必須です。: The ancient civilization's ship—its repairs are essential.
other.超次元生命体、ヒーロークルス！\nここで混沌に呑み込んでやるわ！:
Hyperdimensional lifeform, Hero Kruls!
I'll swallow you whole in chaos right here!
other.超次元生命体、ホロウクルスの消滅を確認。\n皆さまの世界の危機は完全に去りました: T.O.W.E.R.: The ultra-dimensional lifeform, the Hollow Crusader, has been confirmed eradicated. The crisis threatening your worlds is completely over.
other.超次元生命体と戦っても勝ち目はない。\nプルラルクルスに打ち勝った皆さまであって: Even if we fight those extra-dimensional beings, we have no chance. Even you, who defeated the Plural Crusaders, won't be so lucky twice in a row.
other.超次元生命体は、世界の狭間を渡り、\nあらゆる存在を捕食する侵略者……。\nこの:
These hyperdimensional beings traverse the gaps between worlds, preying on all existence…….
If we do nothing, all three worlds will be destroyed.
other.身を以てホロウクルスの恐ろしさを知ってもらえたなら、\n皆さまもきっと、別の世界: If you truly experience the horror of the Hollow Crusaders, I'm sure you'll evacuate to another world.
other.迷いに迷ったあげく、闘兵券を握りしめたまま\n投票に行くのを忘れたりしないよう、: Should we announce a reminder so people don't get so lost they forget to bring their battle tickets to the vote...?
other.逃がすな！ 追え！: Don't let them get away! Chase them!
other.進行が早すぎない！？\nあたしもっと休みたいんだけど！？: Isn't this moving too fast!? I just want a break!
other.過去に行くのか、時を巻き戻すのか、\nどちらが良いでしょう？: Should we go to the past, or rewind time? Which is better?
other.道理で必要以上に協力的だと思ったわ……。: No wonder I thought you were being overly cooperative…
other.遠海の魔物たちを一網打尽にできれば、\n遠征の足がかりにならないかしら。: If we can wipe out those monsters, it could give us a foothold for the expedition.
other.遠足みたいになりそうですねー？: This feels like a school field trip, doesn't it?
other.遺跡のアテはあるけど……。\nただ、そのどれが飛空戦艦用なのかは――: There are some ruin leads, but… I'm not sure which, if any, are for an airship.
other.邪仙だった私に期待してくれている者がいるのなら、\n少しはその期待に応えてやらね: If there are those who still have faith in the fallen immortal that I am, I ought to live up to that expectation, at least a little…
other.釈然としない！\nまぁ、今回の王子たちも似たようなものか。: That doesn't settle it! Well, the Princes this time are pretty much the same.
other.重要なのは敗北や失敗をどう乗り越えるかだ。\nそれこそ、この人気闘兵の主催者様み: What matters is how you overcome defeat and failure—just like the organizer of this popular battle.
other.鋼の都の人たちはたくましいですねぇ……。\nうー、でもやっぱり心配ですよー。: The folks in Steel City are so sturdy… but I'm still worried.
other.鋼の都も、ちゃんと復興していきますよ！\nそのためにお祭りも開いたんですからね！:
The Steel City will be rebuilt properly!
We even held a festival for it!
other.長老の予言によれば、遠くない未来に、\n故郷に災いが降り掛かってくるとのことなの: According to the elder's prophecy, a disaster will befall my hometown in the not-too-distant future.
other.長老も「英傑は一人だけ」なんて言ってなかったので、\nこうなったら超カッコイイ王: The elders never said “only one hero,” so now I wish every single person in this amazing kingdom could lend a hand…!!
other.閉会宣言をしないとですよ！\nヴィラヘルム様の最後の大仕事です！: We have to announce the closing! It's Wilahelm-sama's final big job!
other.開催地の決定からこの短期間で、\nよくぞここまで盛り上げたものだな。: From deciding the venue to now, in such a short span, you've really amped things up.
other.開催地は東の国ですよー！\nふふふ、東の国のお菓子が今から楽しみです♪:
The venue's in the Eastern Kingdom!
Hehe, I can't wait for the sweets from the East♪
other.開催地は鋼の都。\nふっこーしえんを兼ねたお祭りです！: The venue is Steel City—a festival combined with a big showdown!
other.間に合って何よりです。\nそれでは、開始宣言をどうぞ。:
Good thing you made it in time.
Now, go ahead and announce the start.
other.闘兵エネルギーが溜まる事で、\n宝物や聖霊を召喚するとされておる。\nしかも、箱: When that combat energy builds up, it's said you can summon treasures or holy spirits. Moreover, the inside of the box is rumored to connect to another dimension.
other.闘兵券に込められた魔力や想いを蓄積し、\n頂点を極めた者を選出しつつ、\n数々の: By accumulating the magic and resolve poured into the battle tickets, we select those who reach the pinnacle, even summoning countless holy spirits and treasures—
other.闘兵箱の設置は俺様が担当する。\nしかしだ、物質界・魔界・深海の連中が、\n慣れ: I'll handle setting up the battle boxes. But think about it—people from the material world, the demon realm, even the deep sea voting in our unfamiliar heavens? That'll be tough.
other.陥落の屈辱も、敗北の絶望も一度で十分。: One humiliation of defeat, one despair of loss—that's enough.
other.随分と、大きく出た名前ですね……！: That's quite the grand title you've taken on…!
other.雄叫びを上げろ！ 決選投票、開始だぁああああッ！: Raise your battle cries! The final vote begins!
other.集団でさまよう妖怪たちのことを『百鬼夜行』、\nさらに千体もの妖怪が参加するもの: The wandering hordes of yokai are called “Hyakki Yako”, and when a thousand of them gather it's referred to as “Senki Yako”, apparently.
other.雰囲気づくりは大事なんですー。\nほら、こんな機会滅多にないんですから。: Setting the mood is important, you know. Look, opportunities like this don't come around often.
other.頑張っているというより、\n引っ込みがつかなくなっただけのように見えますが。: It's less “doing well” and more like you can't back out now.
other.頼れる相棒は別のことを楽しんでいるから、\n今回は貴方に手を貸さないみたいよ。: Your reliable partner's having fun elsewhere, so they won't be lending a hand this time.
other.風紀の鉄槌！ くらいませっ！: The iron hammer of order! Feel its strike!
other.食べて美味いと快哉を叫ぶか、\n食べずに死ぬか。二つに一つだ。: Either you eat it and shout how delicious it is, or you starve to death. No middle ground.
other.馬鹿な……筋書きよりも早すぎる。\n何故だ、何が起こっている……？:
This is absurd... it's happening faster than the script.
Why is this? What's going on...?
other.駄目、ルールはルール。守らないと。: No, rules are rules. We have to follow them.
other.駆け込み投票に来た者も全員相手にして、\n休みもなしに戦えばそうなるであろうなぁ: If everyone who rushed in to vote had to fight nonstop without a break, they'd end up like this, huh.
other.魂か、寿命に関わる研究資料でしょうか。: Something about souls or research on lifespan, perhaps.
other.魔力の乱れもありませんし、\nしばらくは小さな世界のひとつとして維持され、\nや: There's no magical disturbance, and it'll remain as a small world for a while before naturally fading away.
other.魔法の闘兵箱がかなり重くなってる。\nだいぶ闘兵券をばら撒いたね。: The magical battle box has gotten pretty heavy. We've scattered a lot of battle tickets.
other.魔法の闘兵箱も――むむっ、\n水圧に負けないくらい投票券が詰まってますよ！: The magical battle box—hmm, it's packed with votes as tightly as it resists water pressure!
other.魔法の闘兵箱もすごーく重くなってます。\nふふふ、開票が楽しみですねぇ♪:
The magical battle box has gotten super heavy.
Hehe, I can't wait for the results!
other.魔法都市も魔物の被害から、\nまだ完全に立ち直ってはいないですからねー。: The magical city hasn't fully recovered from the monster attacks yet.
other.魔物たちは、以前に比べその数と強さを増し、\nあまつさえ戦術すら駆使する始末です: The monsters have increased both in number and strength compared to before, and they're even employing tactics.
other.魔王ガリウスを討った英雄、\n天界へ挑む勇者、ポセイオスと刃を交えた戦士……。\: The hero who slew Demon King Garius, the brave who challenged the heavens, the warrior who crossed blades with Poseios… To them, the Prince must be a great hope.
other.魔王城の名において、繋がった世界に祝福を。\nまた異世界の仲間たちが相見えんこと: In the name of the Demon King's Castle, blessings upon the worlds we've linked. May our allies from other realms meet again!
other.魔王決戦の爪痕は、\nまだまだ至る所に残っていますからね。\nお祭りを名目にすれ: The scars from the Demon King's final battle are still everywhere. Framing it as a festival makes everything run more smoothly.
other.魔界の右下に一体何が……。: What on earth is down in the lower right of the Demon Realm…?
other.魔界の未来を想う御心に、皆が共鳴しているのです。: Everyone resonates with your vision for the Demon Realm's future.
other.魔界屈指のタケノコの生産地です……。: It's the premier bamboo shoot production area of the Demon Realm…
other.魔界武術大会にも劣らぬ盛況……。: The excitement rivals even the Demon Realm martial arts tournament…
other.魔界滅亡の危機です……。: The Demon Realm is on the brink of destruction…
other.黒い翼の……？\nいえ、我々も今、この異空間に侵入したばかりで……。\nともあれ: A girl with black wings…? No, we just entered this other dimension ourselves… Anyway, let's start by investigating the cause—
other.黙秘権を行使しますが……はい、肝に銘じておきます。: I invoke my right to remain silent, but… yes, I'll keep that in mind.
other.（――超次元生命体との戦い。\nヒーロークルスとの、最後の決戦……）:
(—A battle against a hyperdimensional lifeform.
The final showdown with the Hero Kruls...)
other.（……あんなこと言ってるけど、\nちょっと楽しそうに見えない？）: (…She says all that, but doesn't it look kind of fun?)
other.（ああ……我が城主よ、写し身であれど、\n記憶のかけらが……）: （Ah… my lord, even as a copy, fragments of memory…）
other.（ああ、あの王子さんや殿さんでも苦戦するんだ……。\nしゃべる余裕すらないなんて: （Ah, even the Prince and Lord are struggling… they don't even have time to speak!）
other.（あっ……。\nだいぶ苦労させられているのですね、この少年は……）: (Ah… He's really giving this kid a hard time…)
other.（いける……敵は本隊でないとはいえ、\nホロウクルスの軍勢を相手に勝っている……: (We can do it… Even though they're not the main force, we're already beating the Hollow Crusade's troops…!)
other.（うぅ……眩しいです、あちこちから後光が……）: (Ugh… it's blinding, halos shining from everywhere…)
other.（かの神像……あやつの法則を操る力も、\n王子にはいくつか、それを打ち砕く術があ:
(That divine statue… Its power to manipulate laws…
The Prince has a few ways to shatter it…)
other.（こういう人なんですよ。\nいや、こういう亜神、と言うべきでしょうか）: (That's just how she is. No, maybe I should call her a demigod.)
other.（この平和な世は、\n我が城主の求めたものではないのかもしれない）: (Perhaps this peaceful world isn't what my lord-mistress sought...)
other.（この身は、幻か、あるいは付喪神のようなものか。\nいつか消えてしまうのか、\n: (Is this body a phantom, or some sort of tsukumogami? Will it vanish someday, or can I wander the world for a while…?)
other.（これが大人の淑女……！\nうぅ、私もいつかこんな素敵な女性に……！）:
(What a mature lady…!
Ugh, I hope I can be a wonderful woman like her someday…)
other.（これは王国と、日の本と、ゲシュペンス島の勝利）: T.O.W.E.R.: (This is a victory for the Kingdom, for the Land of the Rising Sun, and for Geshpens Island.)
other.（すごい大勢が押し寄せちゃう、可能性が……！？）: (There's a chance a massive crowd could surge in…!?)
other.（それはルチアさんを探しているということでは……？）: (So she's looking for Lucia, isn't she…?)
other.（ただでさえ人の集まる催しに、\n目玉イベントができちゃったようなものですから…: (Having a headline event at a gathering that's already crowded…)
other.（ちょっと予想以上の魔力じゃないです？）: (That's a bit more magical power than I expected, isn't it?)
other.（でも……時を司る女神様の魔法お披露目会なんて、\n人気闘兵の会場でやっても大丈: (But… is it really okay to hold a goddess of time's magic demonstration at the Popular Battle venue…?)
other.（どーしましょーシュシュちゃん！？\nすごい方ばかりでお話に入れません！！）: (What should we do, Shushu-chan!? Everyone's so amazing I can't even get a word in!!)
other.（はいはい、危ないからみんな、\n私と一緒に隅っこに避難しようねー）: (Alright, alright, it's dangerous, so everyone, let's take shelter in the corner with me.)
other.（ふぇっ、どうしてです？\nちょうどいい会場だと思いますけど）: (Huh, why not? I think it's actually a perfect venue.)
other.（やった──って、だめだめ。\nわたくしがはしゃぐのは違う）: T.O.W.E.R.: (We did it—no, no. It's not right for me to be giddy.)
other.（より強く、至高の生命体を目指す彼らを、\nどうにか撃退することには成功しました:
(We managed to repel them as they strived to become stronger, supreme beings,
but—)
other.（一緒に頑張りましょう。\n目指せ、立派な淑女です）:
(Let's work together.
Aim to become a proper lady!)
other.（三世界に同時出現した超次元生命体、\n仮称ヒーロークルスは、\n王子たちの戦い:
(The hyperdimensional lifeforms that appeared simultaneously in the three worlds,
provisionally called Hero Kruls,
learned the way the Prince and his allies fight.)
other.（他ならぬ本人がそういうふうに仕組んだのでは……？）: (Could it be that the very person who set this up is behind it…?)
other.（勝った……？ ホロウクルスに、勝った？）: T.O.W.E.R.: (We won…? We actually beat the Hollow Crusaders?)
other.（少数ゆえに対処できなかった天眼ノ国の軍勢……。\nそれも、王子が率いる王国軍が:
(Because of their small numbers, we couldn't handle the Ten-Eye Nation's forces…
But with the kingdom's army led by the Prince, that shouldn't be a problem.)
other.（本当にホロウクルスの眷属に勝ってしまったのです……）: (We actually beat the Hollow Crusade's minions…)
other.（王国だけではない、日の本でも、ゲシュペンス島でも）: (Not just here in the kingdom, but also in Nippon and on Gestpenz Island…)
other.（超次元生命体の圧倒的な力を目の当たりにしても、\n誰一人として諦めて逃げ出すよ: (Even after witnessing the overwhelming power of those extra-dimensional beings, not a single soul gave up and fled.)
other.Ａグループの投票終了ですね。\nクロノシア様のおかげか、いつもより\nこころなし: The voting for Group A is finished. Thanks to Chronosia, it felt a little more intense than usual…
other.Ａグループの投票終了ですね。\n最初はどうなることかと思いましたが、\nいつもの: The A-Group voting's over. I was nervous at first, but it turned out just like any other popular combat, so I'm relieved.
other.Ｂグループの投票も終わりか。\nあっという間だったな。: The B-Group voting's done, too. That was quick.
other.Ｂグループの投票も終わりましたが、\nズィズィーさん、結構頑張っていますね。: Group B's voting is over, Zizi, and you've been doing quite well.
